text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning a controlled image scrub + telemetry drill next Wed (2025-11-12). Need RBAC/KMS/audit sign-offs before we kick.
jon: SGTM. What's the blast radius and rollback plan?
leah: Main goals: remove unused distro pkgs, reprovision minimal base, ensure cosign signing + attestations, and verify audit logs surface to SIEM. Rollback = re-deploy previous signed image (we keep last 3).
cedric: Who owns KMS changes? We'll need a temporary signer key rotation window and additional IAM binding for the build runner service account.
maria: cedric can you add `roles/cloudkms.signer` to `svc-redwood-image-builder@proj` for the 3-hour window? Need to document exact bindings and TTL.
cedric: I can. Proposed command to add binding: ```gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/XXX/locations/global/keyRings/image-signing/cryptoKeys/signer --member=\"serviceAccount:svc-redwood-image-builder@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" --role=\"roles/cloudkms.signer\"```
leah: Also we should gate the binding change with a short-lived access log alert: create an alert when the binding is added and another when key use occurs. sec-bot, can we auto-open an oncall incident when that alert fires?
sec-bot: @leah alert created: `kms-signer-binding-change` -> oncall channel `eng-oncall`.threshold=1.0 :rotating_light:
maria: Audit logging checklist: 1) ensure IAM policy change logs go to `projects/redwood-logs/sinks/kms-audit`; 2) ensure `containeranalysis` and `binaryauthorization` events stream to SIEM; 3) validate cosign signatures are stored in artifact registry metadata.
jon: Vulnerability triage: run `trivy fs --severity HIGH,CRITICAL ./rootfs` pre- and post-scrub, upload results to S3, and create a ticket for any CRITICAL findings. If CRITICALs appear post-scrub, we abort and rollback.
leah: Agree. Also run SBOM generation: `syft packages:json -o sbom.json ./rootfs` and attach to the release. Helps regression checks.
cedric: Can we add a small smoke test to the runtime that hits the `/healthz` and `/predict` endpoints for a few seconds after deploy? If >10% request failures, auto-rollback.
maria: Yes — runtime team will add canary probe (5m window, 95pct success threshold). Add ops runbook snippet: ```if canary_failures > 5% then rollback to last-signed-image; notify #release-war-room; escalate to oncall```
jon: One more: RBAC audit — we need to record who approved the binding change in our audit doc (confluence). I'll make an approvals section and add signatures.
leah: Timeline proposal: 09:00 add binding, 09:10 build & sign, 09:40 deploy canary, 10:00 validation, 11:00 full rollout. 3-hour window ends 12:00 and we revoke binding.
maria: Sounds good. Action items: cedric = create binding + revoke script; jon = vuln/SBOM pipeline and upload; leah = audit alert + docs; sec-bot = incident automation; maria = schedule release + runbook.
cedric: I'll create a short shell for revoke: ```gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding projects/XXX/... --member=\"serviceAccount:svc-redwood-image-builder@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" --role=\"roles/cloudkms.signer\"``` and push to repo under `infra/signer-window/`.
sec-bot: Note: will open incident on `eng-oncall` when `kms-signer-binding-change` fires and will close when revoke script completes.
maria: Thanks all — please ack when you add your PRs/docs. :thumbsup:
jon: ack, prepping PR for vuln/SBOM pipeline.
leah: ack, creating alert and confluence page now.
cedric: ack, will push revoke script and schedule.
sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: `2025-11-12T08:50:00Z` — 10m pre-window reminder posted to #eng-security.
